public.record.label: Change record
public.record.title: FI adopts amended rules on paying for investment research
public.record.kept1: A firm that provides portfolio management may pay for research from a research payment account.
public.record.removed: The account is funded by a specific research charge to the client.
public.record.added: The account is funded from the firm's own resources or from a charge agreed with the client in advance.
public.record.kept2: The budget for each investment strategy is set and reviewed at least once a year.
public.record.soWhat: Three obligations on research payment change on 1 October, and the budget per strategy has no named owner in two of your entities.
public.case.title: A spreadsheet cannot testify.
public.case.lede: Most banks keep their obligations in a spreadsheet and their regulatory watch in an inbox.
public.case.body: That works until a reviewer asks what the obligation said two years ago, who decided it reached the Norwegian entity, and what they had read before deciding. Here, nothing is overwritten, so the answers are still there.
public.case.version.title: No version, no difference
public.case.version.body: The earlier wording is gone, and so is the date it stopped being true.
public.case.decision.title: A colour, not a decision
public.case.decision.body: Green says compliant. It does not say who decided that, or on what.
public.case.coverage.title: Arrivals, not coverage
public.case.coverage.body: An inbox is evidence of what reached you, and of nothing else.
public.what.title: One inventory, one feed, one record.
public.what.inventory.title: Every obligation, with its history
public.what.inventory.body: Each version, the date it took effect, and a readable difference between any two. A reference made three years ago still resolves to the wording it meant then.
public.what.watch.title: Agents find it, your bank decides it
public.what.watch.body: Agents read the sources every day and file what they find as proposals. Nothing else reaches the library.
public.what.ask.title: A question, answered from the provision
public.what.ask.body: The answer quotes the provision it rests on, in the language it was published in, and names its version.
public.what.evidence.title: What applies, and where you stand
public.what.evidence.body: Status for each legal entity, gaps with an owner and a date, and a sign-off by a second person in your bank.
public.method.title: Every change takes the same six steps.
public.method.sighted.name: Sighted.
public.method.sighted.body: A regulator publishes, and an agent reads it that day.
public.method.proposed.name: Proposed.
public.method.proposed.body: The agent drafts the change against the wording in force.
public.method.confirmed.name: Confirmed.
public.method.confirmed.body: A second agent, built differently, checks the draft against the source. Nothing confirms its own work.
public.method.applied.name: Applied.
public.method.applied.body: A new version, with the date it takes effect. The old one stays readable.
public.method.assessed.name: Assessed.
public.method.assessed.body: Your bank decides whether it reaches you, and where you stand.
public.method.signedOff.name: Signed off.
public.method.signedOff.body: A second person in your bank signs, and the evidence closes.
public.method.footnote: A confirmed fact names both agents and never reads as verified by a person. The reading of it is yours, and a person signs that.
public.zones.note: What is shared, what is yours
public.zones.title: The library is shared. The judgement is yours.
public.zones.library.title: The shared library
public.zones.library.body: Instruments, provisions, obligations and effective dates, each with its citation. The same for every bank, so one correction reaches all of them.
public.zones.door.label: Proposals only
public.zones.yours.title: Your zone
public.zones.yours.body: What applies to you, where you stand, your gaps, your evidence and your sign-off. None of it is visible outside your bank.
public.zones.footnote: Your reading of a rule reaches no other bank, no log and no unapproved model.

public.assurance.title: Built to be examined.
public.assurance.access.body: Passkeys, never passwords. Nothing to phish, and no reset link to intercept.
public.assurance.fourEyes.body: Approvals, sign-off, footprint changes and exports take a second person. The same one twice is refused, not flagged afterwards.
public.assurance.isolation.body: One bank's rows cannot be read from another bank's session, whatever the query.
public.assurance.models.body: Approved endpoints in the EU, every call logged, and a fetched page read as material, never as instruction.
public.assurance.ledger.body: Every change is kept beside what it replaced, written in the same breath as the change.
public.assurance.retention.body: Ten years after a record was last used, it is deleted whole.
public.assurance.leaving.body: Two approvals, your final export, then every row of yours is deleted, the audit trail included.
public.assurance.pack.body: The architecture, the controls, the audit model and the sub-processors, written for the review.
public.questions.title: Questions we are asked.
public.questions.ai.a: It finds, drafts and proposes. What a second agent confirms is marked as confirmed by machine; what it means for your bank is yours to decide.
public.questions.oneEntity.q: Can we start with one legal entity?
public.questions.oneEntity.a: Yes. Widening the footprint later is a decision with a record behind it, not a setting somebody changed on a Friday.
public.questions.whoSees.a: Nobody. What is shared is the public fact. What you make of it stays in your zone.
public.questions.libraryWrong.q: What if the library is wrong?
public.questions.libraryWrong.a: Say so on the record; your note stays inside your bank. The correction arrives the other way, from the agents' re-check against the source, through the same proposal door as everything else.
public.questions.getIn.a: Your administrator invites them, and they enrol on their own device. There is no password to set.
public.questions.cost.a: On application, against the footprint in scope. Reading costs nothing per head: a record nobody can open is worth little.
public.request.title: Access is by invitation.
public.request.invited: If your bank already uses bleqq, your administrator sends the invitation.
public.request.introduce: If it does not, write to us and we will arrange an introduction.
public.footer.colophon: Set in Libre Caslon Display and Hanken Grotesk, with Noto Sans Mono for legal references.
